title: Coherent integral dualizing presentation
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$. Use the coefficient categories, derived tensor and internal Hom, and constructible exceptional functors of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. For a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, put $R=\mathcal O_E$. A coherent integral dualizing datum consists of an object $\omega$ of the completed derived-complete bounded constructible category and isomorphisms $r_n:\omega\otimes_R^L R/(\varpi_E^{n+1})\cong Ra_{X,n+1}^!(R/(\varpi_E^{n+1}))$ for every $n\ge0$. For every $n\le m$, the normalized DVR reduction transition followed by restriction of $r_n$ equals $r_m$ followed by the exceptional dualizing transition. These are data and their coherence equation, without an existence assertion.
